title: LLM-Human Pipeline for Cultural Grounding of Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on cultural norms and their grounding in conversations, identifying and evaluating 'Norm Concepts' such as 'Filial piety,' 'Respect for Authority,' and other social expectations. These concepts represent the moral and behavioral value systems of a community. The paper benchmarks LLMs on their ability to detect violations of these cultural and ethical norms.
